_note: The member's geopolitical filter: its classes, where each comes from, its codes, and the words each class starts from. An item passes when its weight G reaches theta and its class is among the classes chosen in member.json's filter. The six COW classes are defined by the Correlates of War codebooks; the eight marked cow:false are not from COW. A class with needs_entry false (AI and computing, and its two sub-classes, AI alignment and recursive self-improvement, marked parent: ai) passes without naming one of the author's entries; an item that names no entry can take only such a class. Words are matched as whole token sequences after lower-casing, removing accents and splitting on anything but letters, digits and apostrophes. The author's pass/drop marks correct the words (see filter/geofilter.py).

classes.name: War
classes.source: COW War Data v4.0 (inter-, extra- and non-state wars) and v5.1 (intra-state wars)
classes.codes: War type 1 inter-state; 2 colonial, 3 imperial (extra-state); 4 civil war for central control, 5 civil war over local issues, 6 regional internal, 7 intercommunal (intra-state); 8 non-state war in non-state territory, 9 non-state war across state borders. A war is sustained combat with at least 1,000 battle-related deaths in twelve months. MID hostility level 5.

terms.src: COW war typology: inter-state, extra-state, intra-state and non-state wars
COW intra-state war types 4 and 5: civil war for central control, over local issues
COW extra-state war types 2 and 3: colonial, imperial
COW intra-state war type 7: intercommunal
COW war threshold: 1,000 battle-related deaths in twelve months

classes.name: Militarized dispute
classes.source: COW Militarized Interstate Disputes 5.0 (1816-2014): MID 5.0 codebook and incident coding manual
classes.codes: Hostility level 1 no militarized action, 2 threat to use force, 3 display of force, 4 use of force, 5 war. Highest action: threats 1 use force, 2 blockade, 3 occupy territory, 4 declare war, 5 use CBR weapons, 6 join war [level 2]; displays 7 show of force, 8 alert, 9 nuclear alert, 10 mobilization, 11 fortify border, 12 border violation [3]; uses 13 blockade, 14 occupation of territory, 15 seizure, 16 attack, 17 clash, 18 declaration of war, 19 use of CBR weapons [4]; 20 begin, 21 join interstate war [5]. Fatality level 0-6. COW codes these for state forces; here they are read for any armed actor.

classes.name: AI and computing
classes.source: Not from COW, and from no codebook: the author's own computing ledger, the Whizz Kids Witness's design story in eight chapters, and the terms that measured AI news in the feeds on 2026-11-22. Added at the author's word, 2026-11-22.
classes.codes: The ledger's chapters: 1 personal machines and common connections (1974-1988); 2 the Internet becomes a shared Web (1989-2003); 3 social, mobile and cloud ecosystems (2003-2011); 4 learning and perceptual building blocks (2011-2022); 5 perception becomes a developer platform (2015-2022); 6 conversation becomes delegated action (2022-2026); 7 competition over agents and infrastructure, the Agentic Computing War (2026); 8 future stages toward Super Intelligence (2026 onward; 82.80, 30 December 2037). Unlike the other classes, an item of this one passes without naming one of the author's entries.
